name: smwpatches-star-slide-kill-gfx-fix
title: Star/Slide Kill GFX Fix
description:
This patch fixes a few SMW sprites showing broken GFX when killed with Star Power or by sliding:
- Bob-Omb (when exploding)
- Bowser's Bowling Balls
- Iggy's Balls
- Blarggs
- Fishin' Boo
- Falling Spike
- Bowser Statue Fireball
- Grinder (not line-guided)
- Reflecting Fireball
- Bowser Statue (jumping)
